title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook with quality gating and metrics integration
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Add a per-prompt CI hook that runs the eval-harness per-prompt regression checks and enforces a quality gate based on configurable thresholds. This PR centralizes per-prompt metrics integration with CI to catch regressions early and make rollbacks predictable. Goals: 1) run per-prompt evals as a lightweight CI job, 2) surface per-prompt metrics (accuracy/semantic-similarity/fluency) in build output, 3) fail builds when prompt-level regressions exceed thresholds, 4) allow opt-out and baseline pinning for unstable prompt sets. Changes: - new ci/hooks/per-prompt-eval.yml: CI job that orchestrates eval-harness runner with snapshot baselines and threshold config - eval-harness/ci/compare_metrics.py: script to compute per-prompt deltas and apply gating rules - eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml: default gate thresholds and allowlist - eval-harness/tests/test_ci_integration.py: integration tests + lightweight fixtures - docs/eval-harness/ci-hooks.md: documentation + examples - small refactor to eval-harness/runner.py to expose a metrics JSON output. Format: the CI job runs eval-harness with --output-json, uploads artifact, then runs compare_metrics.py which emits a human-friendly summary and sets non-zero exit on gate violations. Compatibility: integrates with existing metrics exporter (Prometheus + test metrics upload) and supports a dry-run mode. Security: artifacts contain only anonymized prompt IDs and aggregated statistics, not raw prompt content. Rollout plan: 1) merge to main, 2) enable as optional CI job on eval-harness repo, 3) enable required gating for critical prompt-sets after 2 weeks of green runs. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for compare_metrics - [x] CI job and artifact upload - [x] docs and usage examples - [x] Linear linkage and product approval - [x] lightweight integration test in CI

Priya: asked for clearer artifact sanitization; updated compare_metrics to strip raw prompt text and use prompt IDs. Samir: suggested adding a small smoke test in CI; added test_ci_integration.py.
